//The mechanism that snmalloc will use for thread destructors.
//  Valid options are: CXX11_DESTRUCTORS (use C++11 destructors,
// may depend on the C++ runtime library), CXX11_THREAD_ATEXIT_DIRECT
// (use the glibc call for libstdc++ directly), PTHREAD_DESTRUCTORS
// (use pthreads, may interact badly with C++ on some platforms,
// such as macOS) THREAD_CLEANUP (depend on an explicit call to
// _malloc_thread_cleanup on thread exit, supported by FreeBSD's
// threading implementation and possibly elsewhere)
SNMALLOC_CLEANUP:STRING=CXX11_DESTRUCTORS
